offers_products.reason: Sells specialty chemicals: cellulose derivatives (Natrosol), PVP polymers, foam control agents, excipients, and personal care ingredients.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured specialty ingredients; technical support and R&D collaboration accompany product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Ingredients are sold to manufacturers of coatings, pharma, personal care and food products, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to formulators and manufacturers in pharmaceutical, coatings, personal care, food, construction and agriculture markets.

recurring_revenue.reason: Specialty ingredients are repeat-ordered by formulators who build them into ongoing production of their products.

cyclical_demand.reason: Much demand is pharma, personal care, food and nutraceutical ingredients, which are fairly stable, though coatings and construction are somewhat cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Chemical ingredients are bought in frequent, repeat orders and are small relative to customers' spending.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured chemical products and technology platforms, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large pharmaceutical, personal care, coatings and food manufacturers, though some smaller formulators buy too.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing plants, with ongoing expansions in Brazil and Ireland, plus R&D labs.

notes: Large-customer and cyclicality answers are judgment calls given the mix of end markets.
